mapper.insert: insert into planners (start_day, end_day, member_id, name, comment, exposure) values(#{startDay}, #{endDay}, #{memberId}, #{name}, #{comment}, #{exposure})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS p_id, p.start_day AS p_start_day, p.end_day AS p_end_day, p.name AS p_name, m.id AS m_id, m.name AS m_name, m.email AS m_email, m.password AS m_password, m.role AS m_role FROM planners p JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.id WHERE p.id = #{plannerId}

SELECT p.id AS p_id, p.start_day AS p_start_day, p.end_day AS p_end_day, p.name AS p_name, m.id AS m_id, m.name AS m_name, m.email AS m_email, m.password AS m_password, m.role AS m_role FROM planners p JOIN members m ON p.member_id = m.id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId}
